set: A: the site as web pages: the six pages at rest, the application with its controls on, the message page for touch devices, and the controls at their real size

issues.where: the three dropdown controls on Step 2 (Contact number, Date of birth, Audio volume)
issues.what: each renders as a plain empty bar with only a chevron; there is no selected value or placeholder text, so at delivery size they read as blank, possibly broken inputs rather than controls a visitor could use
issues.fix: give every dropdown a visible placeholder or currently selected value, e.g. 'Select...', so its state is legible before interaction

issues.where: the lower two-thirds of Steps 3, 4 and 5 (also set-A-05.png and set-A-02.png)
issues.what: content is parked in the top band and the rest of the page is bare background; at rest each step looks half-finished rather than deliberately sparse, with the mechanism on Step 3 hanging into a large void
issues.fix: either vertically centre the main content of each step or bring the useful content up (grow the panel/control cluster) so each page balances within the viewport

issues.where: the three perk cards (Unlimited PTO, Competitive Salary, Flexible Hours)
issues.what: text sits at the top with an empty bottom half and a divider rule under the description that separates nothing; the cards look like placeholders awaiting content
issues.fix: reduce card height to hug the content or distribute heading, body and rule through the card so the empty area at the bottom disappears

issues.where: the arrow cursor sitting mid-page (also present in set-A-01, set-A-04 and set-A-05, each at a different position)
issues.what: a baked-in cursor floats over otherwise clean stills; on a page at rest it reads as capture noise, not part of the site
issues.fix: capture or compose the at-rest stills without the cursor, or place it consistently on the primary action if it is meant to show intent

issues.where: bottom end of the tube mechanism, lower right
issues.what: the tube descending from the funnel dish fades out mid-page with no socket, cut line or floor contact, so the mechanism reads as clipped artwork rather than something bolted to the page
issues.fix: end the tube in a collar or socket element, or fade it out with a clear shadow so it reads as receding rather than truncated
